audit.method: Direct model translation followed by a complete source-target editorial reading of Leah’s complete art show and Clint asking Emily to the Grampleton Carnival. Every spoken line, artwork title and description, artist statement, gender branch, auction amount, romantic hesitation, date invitation, and character voice was reviewed in full event context against the canonical Ukrainian glossary. Event commands, actors, movement, timing, event and mail conditions, placeholders, gender branches, dialogue delimiters, emotion markers, music and sound IDs, and all non-text payloads were preserved and structurally compared with English. Remaining Town records and full-locale final audits remain pending.
